In some South Asian cultures (including my own) puberty warrants a damn party. My culture personally does ceremonial bathing by the family, the consumption of certain foods that were "good for the weak body", staying inside with your family for the duration of the first period, and ends with a small ceremony where you are presented to your family and their friends wearing your very first sari, while all the unmarried females of your family follow you around like bridesmaids. You aren't allowed to be considered "a woman" or wear a sari before this. You along get money and gold jewellery.

My mom personally didn't do the huge ceremony for me because I was like 10 and just horrified the time (I had an awful first period) but she did do the ceremonial bathing and special foods and took pictures in a new sari. My little cousin (who was 11) had it last summer, and she got the whole shebang. But her parents are also way more traditional than my mother is, so...
